## Network Graph
Nodes currently connected to GB7CAM

Two renderings of the same routing data, side by side. **Spoke** draws an edge from each node to the peer it was learned through - that is what the NODES table actually records, and it produces a star shape because the multi-hop chain behind each entry isn't preserved. **Matrix** instead joins every pair of nodes that share a peer, treating "reachable via the same neighbour" as a connection. Neither is the real network topology; the gap between the two is the point.

<div style="padding:10px;font-family:sans-serif;">
  <input id="filter" placeholder="Filter node (e.g. GB7FCI)" style="padding:6px;width:240px;">
</div>

<div style="display:flex; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
<div style="flex:1; min-width:300px;">
<h3 style="font-family:sans-serif; text-align:center; margin:6px 0;">Spoke</h3>
<div id="network-spoke" style="height: 50vh; border: 1px solid #ddd; background: #ffffff;"></div>
</div>
<div style="flex:1; min-width:300px;">
<h3 style="font-family:sans-serif; text-align:center; margin:6px 0;">Matrix</h3>
<div id="network-matrix" style="height: 50vh; border: 1px solid #ddd; background: #ffffff;"></div>
</div>
</div>

<script src="https://unpkg.com/vis-network/standalone/umd/vis-network.min.js"></script>

<script>
const API = "https://api.gb7cam.org.uk/graph";

let spokeNodes, spokeEdges, networkSpoke;
let matrixNodes, matrixEdges, networkMatrix;

/* ----------------------------
   NODE NORMALISATION
---------------------------- */
function normalizeId(id) {
  if (!id) return id;
  if (id.startsWith("GB7CAM")) return "GB7CAM";
  return id;
}

/* ----------------------------
   NODE TYPE COLOURS
---------------------------- */
function nodeColor(id) {

  if (id === "GB7CAM") return "#ff6b6b"; // core

  if (id.startsWith("GB7")) return "#4dabf7"; // BBS/mailbox
  if (id.startsWith("MB7")) return "#20c997"; // data nodes

  if (/^(G[0-9]|M[0-9]|2E|2M)/.test(id)) return "#ffd43b"; // UK personals

  return "#adb5bd";
}

/* ----------------------------
   PORT COLOURS
---------------------------- */
function portColor(port) {
  switch(String(port)) {
    case "1": return "#2ca02c"; // RF
    case "2": return "#ffbf00"; // telnet
    case "3": return "#1f77b4"; // AXIP
    default: return "#999999";
  }
}

/* ----------------------------
   EDGE WIDTH (quality)
---------------------------- */
function width(q) {
  return Math.max(1, Math.min(8, (q || 50) / 40));
}

/* ----------------------------
   ACTIVE EDGE RULE
---------------------------- */
function isBroken(e) {
  return (e.quality === 0);
}

/* ----------------------------
   NODE MAP (shared by both views)
---------------------------- */
function buildNodeMap(data) {
  const nodeMap = new Map();

  (data.nodes || []).forEach(n => {
    const id = normalizeId(n.id);
    let label = id;

    // only your node is simplified
    if (id === "GB7CAM") {
      label = "GB7CAM";
    } else if (n.alias) {
      label = id + "\n" + n.alias;
    }

    nodeMap.set(id, { id, label, color: nodeColor(id) });
  });

  // ensure endpoints exist
  (data.edges || []).forEach(e => {
    const s = normalizeId(e.source);
    const t = normalizeId(e.target);

    if (!nodeMap.has(s)) nodeMap.set(s, { id: s, label: s, color: nodeColor(s) });
    if (!nodeMap.has(t)) nodeMap.set(t, { id: t, label: t, color: nodeColor(t) });
  });

  return nodeMap;
}

/* ----------------------------
   SPOKE VIEW: node -> via_peer, as the NODES table actually has it
---------------------------- */
function buildSpoke(data, nodeMap) {
  const nodes = new vis.DataSet([...nodeMap.values()]);

  const edges = new vis.DataSet(
    (data.edges || []).map((e, i) => ({
      id: i,
      from: normalizeId(e.source),
      to: normalizeId(e.target),
      label: e.quality ? String(e.quality) : "",
      width: width(e.quality),
      arrows: "to",
      color: { color: portColor(e.port), highlight: "#000" },
      dashes: isBroken(e)
    }))
  );

  return { nodes, edges };
}

/* ----------------------------
   MATRIX VIEW: every pair of nodes that share a peer, joined
---------------------------- */
function buildPeerSets(edges) {
  const sets = new Map(); // peer -> Set of node ids reachable via it

  (edges || []).forEach(e => {
    if (e.type !== "route") return; // "link" edges are GB7CAM's own AXUDP links, not route data
    const peer = normalizeId(e.target);
    const node = normalizeId(e.source);
    if (node === peer) return; // a peer's self-entry in its own NODES table
    if (!sets.has(peer)) sets.set(peer, new Set());
    sets.get(peer).add(node);
  });

  return sets;
}

function buildMatrixEdgeList(peerSets) {
  const byPair = new Map(); // "a|b" -> {from, to}

  peerSets.forEach((nodeSet) => {
    const members = [...nodeSet];
    for (let i = 0; i < members.length; i++) {
      for (let j = i + 1; j < members.length; j++) {
        const key = [members[i], members[j]].sort().join("|");
        if (!byPair.has(key)) {
          byPair.set(key, { from: members[i], to: members[j] });
        }
      }
    }
  });

  return [...byPair.values()];
}

// Evenly-spaced circular layout: a clique this dense is unreadable under
// force physics, and the crossing chords are themselves the point.
function circularLayout(ids, radius = 320) {
  const layout = new Map();
  ids.forEach((id, i) => {
    const angle = (2 * Math.PI * i) / ids.length;
    layout.set(id, { angle, x: radius * Math.cos(angle), y: radius * Math.sin(angle) });
  });
  return layout;
}

function buildMatrix(data, nodeMap) {
  const peerSets = buildPeerSets(data.edges);

  // Only nodes that appear in at least one peer's set - GB7CAM and the
  // peers themselves aren't "reachable via a peer" in this sense.
  const memberIds = new Set();
  peerSets.forEach(set => set.forEach(id => memberIds.add(id)));

  const ids = [...memberIds];
  const layout = circularLayout(ids);

  const nodes = new vis.DataSet(ids.map(id => {
    const base = nodeMap.get(id) || { id, label: id, color: nodeColor(id) };
    const pos = layout.get(id);
    // Native canvas label, kept short (callsign only, no alias) since
    // this is a dense circle - vadjust nudges it vertically away from
    // the node using the node's own position on the circle, so top-half
    // labels sit above their dot and bottom-half labels sit below,
    // instead of the default fixed offset that reads fine on a sparse
    // graph but collides constantly here. This is a real vis-network
    // node property, so it scales and stays attached correctly under
    // zoom/pan - unlike an earlier attempt at a hand-positioned HTML
    // overlay, which didn't.
    return {
      ...base,
      label: id,
      title: base.label,
      x: pos.x,
      y: pos.y,
      fixed: true,
      font: { size: 7, color: "#444", vadjust: -10 * Math.sign(Math.sin(pos.angle) || 1) }
    };
  }));

  const edges = new vis.DataSet(
    buildMatrixEdgeList(peerSets).map((e, i) => ({
      id: i,
      from: e.from,
      to: e.to,
      // Semi-transparent so overlapping chords read as density (darker
      // where many peers' cliques cross) rather than a solid grey mess.
      color: { color: "rgba(90,90,90,0.12)", highlight: "#000" },
      width: 1
    }))
  );

  return { nodes, edges };
}

/* ----------------------------
   RENDER
---------------------------- */
function render(data) {
  const nodeMap = buildNodeMap(data);

  ({ nodes: spokeNodes, edges: spokeEdges } = buildSpoke(data, nodeMap));
  ({ nodes: matrixNodes, edges: matrixEdges } = buildMatrix(data, nodeMap));

  networkSpoke = new vis.Network(document.getElementById("network-spoke"), {
    nodes: spokeNodes,
    edges: spokeEdges
  }, {
    physics: {
      stabilization: true,
      barnesHut: { gravitationalConstant: -9000, springLength: 140 }
    },
    nodes: { shape: "dot", size: 12, font: { color: "#222" } },
    edges: { smooth: { type: "dynamic" } }
  });

  networkMatrix = new vis.Network(document.getElementById("network-matrix"), {
    nodes: matrixNodes,
    edges: matrixEdges
  }, {
    physics: false,
    nodes: { shape: "dot", size: 6 },
    edges: { smooth: false },
    interaction: { hover: true }
  });

  setupFilter();
}

/* ----------------------------
   FILTER WITH +1 NEIGHBOUR HOP, applied to both views
---------------------------- */
function applyFilterTo(nodes, edges, q) {
  // Batched into one nodes.update()/edges.update() call each, rather than
  // one call per item - on the matrix view's ~2000 edges, per-item updates
  // meant thousands of individual DataSet writes (each triggering its own
  // internal recalculation) on every keystroke, which is what made the
  // page feel unresponsive while filtering.
  if (!q) {
    nodes.update(nodes.map(n => ({ id: n.id, hidden: false })));
    edges.update(edges.map(e => ({ id: e.id, hidden: false })));
    return;
  }

  const seed = new Set();
  nodes.forEach(n => {
    if (n.id.includes(q)) seed.add(n.id);
  });

  // +1 hop expansion. Checked against the frozen seed set, not the
  // growing matchNodes - otherwise a node added mid-loop can trigger
  // further additions in the same pass, cascading well past one hop
  // on a dense graph depending on edge order.
  const matchNodes = new Set(seed);
  edges.forEach(e => {
    if (seed.has(e.from) || seed.has(e.to)) {
      matchNodes.add(e.from);
      matchNodes.add(e.to);
    }
  });

  nodes.update(nodes.map(n => ({ id: n.id, hidden: !matchNodes.has(n.id) })));
  edges.update(edges.map(e => ({
    id: e.id,
    hidden: !(matchNodes.has(e.from) && matchNodes.has(e.to))
  })));
}

function applyFilter() {
  const q = document.getElementById("filter").value.trim().toUpperCase();
  applyFilterTo(spokeNodes, spokeEdges, q);
  applyFilterTo(matrixNodes, matrixEdges, q);
}

/* ----------------------------
   FILTER EVENT (debounced so a dense matrix pass doesn't run on every
   single keystroke while still typing)
---------------------------- */
function debounce(fn, delayMs) {
  let timer;
  return (...args) => {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = setTimeout(() => fn(...args), delayMs);
  };
}

function setupFilter() {
  document.getElementById("filter")
    .addEventListener("input", debounce(applyFilter, 150));
}

/* ----------------------------
   LOAD
---------------------------- */
fetch(API)
  .then(r => r.json())
  .then(render);

</script>
